name: Yucca — all Kew-accepted species
status: 4 archetypal species (full list archived in docs/plant_archive)
notes: All 55 species accepted by Kew POWO (hybrids dropped). Nearly the whole genus is North American dry country: Mojave/Sonoran/Chihuahuan deserts, the Great Plains, Texas limestone, the Mexican plateau, plus a few SE-US dune species and one Chiapas rainforest epiphyte. Yucca moths are the only pollinator; where insects are absent it spreads by rhizome offsets only. Tree forms use the gnarled shape (Phase 6 should give the cactus/gnarled builder a dagger-crown option); rosettes use spike_rosette, which exists.
